title: Winner carry-forward between rounds
description: Each round starts from scratch — the agent never sees the previous round winning DSL. This causes declining fitness (70.65 to 58.23 percent over 3 rounds). Fix: pass the previous round winner full DSL to the next round agent as a starting point with instruction to improve it. The condenser extracts fragments but loses the complete architecture. Skills alone are not enough context.
definition-of-done: In loop.py, the winner DSL from round N is injected into the user message for round N+1 members using the same technique. The agent is told the previous best similarity and instructed to refine or start fresh. Fitness across rounds should be non-declining on average.
testing-plan: Run voyage for 3+ rounds on skull reference. Verify round 2 agent message contains round 1 winner DSL. Verify fitness does not systematically decline across rounds.
